name: python-domain-modeling
description: Encode Python domain invariants with types, immutable structures, explicit states, and boundary validation.

interface.longDescription: Python-specific patterns for making invalid domain states difficult to construct with unions, frozen dataclasses, semantic types, validated values, explicit transitions, exhaustive matching, and boundary conversion.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Python type-driven domain modeling when designing or refactoring domain states, invariants, lifecycle APIs, and boundary conversions.
